{"kind":"player-gear","definition":{"id":"return-knot","name":"回信结","slotId":"gear.waist","summary":"本人灵抗提高；归巢余息使五米内友方飞剑回灵提高14%/级，与共鸣玉择强生效。","spiritPolicy":"relay","maxLevel":5,"introducedInLootPoolVersion":4,"appearanceSceneGuid":"29b015d4-13f0-5b5f-bca7-a6f8465de471","inventorySize":{"width":2,"height":1},"effectRefs":[{"effectId":"effect.gear.return-knot.spirit-resistance","assetGuid":"d3874bd5-e73a-57c7-80be-c525bcd13e53","programFingerprint":"effect-program/1:7038:f7545b3f3c9eaafb"},{"effectId":"effect.aura.returning-letter","assetGuid":"01e34942-a352-58a7-bf42-0742da19ee88","programFingerprint":"effect-program/1:967:d63477d8a41e81c0"}],"affixPool":{"sourceEffectId":"effect.gear.return-knot.spirit-resistance","version":2,"excludedReason":"回信结只随机本叶逐项允许的效果；未审定词不能因其他装备已有相关效果而进入。","rules":[{"effectId":"effect.affix.minglv-counter-resonance","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"回信结没有鸣律剑击消耗雷痕的事件，不能由被击中触发。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.contact-weakness","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"旧绳与封缄没有热刃接触，也没有给敌人施加灼弱的载体。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.quick-withdrawal","allowed":true,"weight":0.6,"reason":"轻绳不妨碍腰身收势，能缩短普通翻滚的恢复；使用与其他护具相同的翻滚规则。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.metal-ward","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"封缄的金色装饰不是隔绝金行灵息的护层。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.earth-ward","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"绳结没有镇土封印或厚重土行隔层，不因腰具分类授予土抗。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.water-ward","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"回信补灵并非水行屏障，蓝绳不等于抗水。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.fire-ward","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"信封没有隔热工艺，也不把“信火不熄”叙事当作耐火机制。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.wood-ward","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"旧纸与绳不是活木护持，没有木行抗侵配方。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.impact-guard","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"轻绳结没有分散撞击的承力结构；卸势虽可出现在其他护具上，本件仍不能获得。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.qi-efficiency","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"本件没有一把剑的启动、命中、外飞与续穿耗费账本。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.turning-efficiency","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"绳结不拥有剑的转弯半径，不能把腰身灵活传给全部剑的轨迹。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.owner-qi-recovery","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"当前词仅有武器载体许可；本件选择容量与距离补给，不复制主人产灵路线。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.water-mending","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"回信结没有活木、水养或疗伤功能，归巢余息不等于缓慢回血。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.blade-integrity","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"本件没有剑体器命槽，不能把护具主人属性误接为剑命。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.fuel-efficiency","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"绳结不进行外飞燃命，没有可由本词减耗的自身剑体过程。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.repair-reception","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"信封不接剑体维修，不能把主人受治疗与剑体修复混用。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.blade-concord","allowed":true,"weight":0.75,"reason":"封缄传递近阵协作，使4米内友方器物增伤；本件从蓝色品质起可出现，需要已开放可攻击的器物。","minimumRarityOverride":2,"requiresReceiver":"attack-equipment"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.canopy","allowed":true,"weight":0.4,"reason":"信封护符可带近邻防护，4米内按比例提高友方已有护甲和灵抗；金色品质起可出现。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.tide-return","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"默认归巢余息在可随机品质下加快至少28%、覆盖5米，盖住4米内最高19.2%的同件回潮，这是原配方拒绝回潮的依据。作者调数后仍保留该准入决定，不自动新增同组随机技能，也不保证调后仍完全覆盖。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.critical-force","allowed":true,"weight":0.45,"reason":"封缄传递把握破绽的时机，6米内提高实际暴击收益；须有可暴击器物。","requiresReceiver":"critical-equipment"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.cast-mobility","allowed":true,"weight":0.45,"reason":"腰间传信符使施法走位更从容，6米内减轻合法移动法术惩罚；无此受体则拒绝。","requiresReceiver":"mobile-spell-with-movement-penalty"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.tempered","allowed":true,"weight":0.4,"reason":"旧封缄可选实刃共振，让6米内友方器物的物理伤害提高；需要已开放能打出物理伤害的器物。","requiresReceiver":"physical-damage-equipment"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.keen","allowed":true,"weight":0.55,"reason":"传信封印帮助近邻器物捕捉破绽，6米暴击概率光环；需可暴击受体。","requiresReceiver":"critical-equipment"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.swift","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"流光只加快携带它的那把飞剑补灵；本件不能获得，也不能与归巢余息当作两个相加的同类光环。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.windborne","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"已退新随机，旧绳没有已获准的驱风光环分支，不为补数量复活旧词。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.far-seeking","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"已退新随机；索敌范围不是补灵光环范围，不能换名复用。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.mountain","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"退池旧词的对敌冲量不是腰结稳定性，本件无重击推敌工艺。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.guardian","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"窄绳与信封没有覆盖身体的承力甲片，不按所有防具一律加护甲。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.vital","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"信封的灵息储存不是气血容器，不因生存后缀槽而扩生命上限。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.spirit-ward","allowed":true,"weight":1.1,"reason":"重封护符强化本件的灵识防线，与回信结原有灵抗点数相加；蓝色品质起可出现。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.cloud-step","allowed":true,"weight":0.65,"reason":"轻腰结可配疾行结法，增加主人的平常移速，帮助传递近身补给；蓝色品质起可出现。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.resonant","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"已退新随机；信封回响不是扩大剑刃或法域命中体积的工艺。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.enduring","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"已退新随机；保存旧信不是延长攻击状态的消费者。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.clear-water","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"绳结不减涉水阻力，信封防潮不等于主人涉水减速抵抗。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.metal-flat","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"本件无打出金伤的命中包，金封边不是武器刃。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.metal-increased","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"没有自身金伤基底，不能借附近金剑给本件造金伤百分比受体。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.wood-flat","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"纸张与旧绳不发木行弹道，本件没有本器附木伤。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.wood-increased","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"本件没有木伤分量，也没有木伤转换工序。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.water-flat","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"归巢余息是补灵而不是水伤技能，蓝绳不追加水击。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.water-increased","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"回灵速率没有水伤基底，水盛不能放大归巢余息。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.fire-flat","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"封蜡金印不是火刃，本件没有附火命中。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.fire-increased","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"本件没有火伤分量，不能从火剑配装继承其局部乘区。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.earth-flat","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"腰间封缄不撞出土伤，没有本器固定土伤消费者。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.earth-increased","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"本件无土伤基底；稳定绳结不能作土伤比例借口。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.spellpower","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"现词是本器术法伤害；回信结无攻击器物身份，不能偷改主人全局输出。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.qi-capacity","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"藏灵增加的是携带它的那把飞剑的器气上限；不能把它当作增加主人灵力上限的聚气。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.physical-speed","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"迅手只加快物理出招动作；回信结本身不会出招，不能获得这个效果。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.spell-speed","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"速诀需要实际的法术施放动作；回信结没有这种动作，不能因为名字里有“诀”就获得。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.artifact-speed","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"当前仅本器御器动作加速，本件没有已审通过的范围施放速度光环。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.hit-recovery","allowed":true,"weight":0.55,"reason":"腰结收束多余摆动，使主人实际受击后更快恢复动作；蓝色品质起可出现。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.xuantie-hardening","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"仍是玄铁护心镜专属锻甲工序；本件无承力甲层。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.xuantie-heart-lining","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"虽然已共享，窄绳与信封没有包覆脏腑的护心衬垫，不扩主人气血容量。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.qingxin-clear-radiance-radius","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"固定属于清心额带且只绑定同件清辉，不能改目标到归巢余息。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.owner-qi-capacity","allowed":true,"weight":0.95,"reason":"封缄内折符页可暂存主人的灵息，给下一轮近身供灵留余量；必须有真实主人容量与耗费受体。","requiresReceiver":"owner-qi-reservoir-consumer"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.edge-honing","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"结扣稳定灵息以抵御术式，没有接触刃口的研磨材料，不能把收束灵息称为磨锋。"}]},"modifiers":[{"stat":"spiritResistance","operation":"flat","value":1,"source":"gear:return-knot"}],"auras":[{"id":"aura.returning-letter","name":"归巢余息","version":1,"effectRefs":[{"effectId":"effect.aura.returning-letter","assetGuid":"01e34942-a352-58a7-bf42-0742da19ee88","programFingerprint":"effect-program/1:967:d63477d8a41e81c0"}],"rangeHintGuid":"1e4e1134-0a8c-5b28-a7f9-99e6318b04fe","radiusMeters":5,"stackingGroup":"sword-qi-recharge","targets":"swords","effects":[{"stat":"weaponQiRechargeRate","operation":"increased","value":0.14}]}]}}
